http_pairing.check_mcp_capability: Internally POST /v0/public-access/grants, POST /v0/capabilities, and POST /v0/checks, then DELETE /v0/agents/{agent_id}. The Preview bearer is never disclosed to the MCP caller. Does not POST /v0/usage-events.
http_pairing.check_mcp_capability_with_previous: With the optional previous argument: internally POST /v0/public-access/grants and POST /v0/revision-checks, then DELETE /v0/agents/{agent_id}. structuredContent adds revision_receipt beside the unchanged report. Does not POST /v0/usage-events.
http_pairing.usage_events: To attest CONTINUE, UPDATE_INTEGRATION, or HOLD after a finished check, use REST POST /v0/usage-events with the same still-valid grant credential.

annotation_schema_keywords.caller_provided_inputs: format, or readOnly true, anywhere inside an input property the caller provides makes that input check UNSUPPORTED; common MCP SDKs enforce format on tool inputs
annotation_schema_keywords.invalid_value: a value of another type is UNSUPPORTED
annotation_schema_keywords.semantics: accepted as annotations that do not change which instances validate; not evaluated
annotation_schema_keywords.write_only_required_output: writeOnly true on any schema along a required output path makes that output check UNSUPPORTED
annotation_schema_keywords.x_mcp_header: inputSchema only; checked against the MCP 2026-07-28 Streamable HTTP rules (HTTP token, case-insensitively unique, on a string, integer or boolean property reached only through properties keys). A violation FAILs tool:<name>:x-mcp-header because conforming clients must exclude the tool; x-mcp-header in outputSchema is UNSUPPORTED

array_item_schema_check.evidence_paths: RFC 6901 JSON Pointers relative to the selected schema root
array_item_schema_check.scope: all explicit type=array nodes in supported schema-bearing positions

agent_gotchas: Idempotency-Key is required on POST /v0/capabilities, POST /v0/checks, POST /v0/revision-checks, and POST /v0/usage-events; optional only on POST /v0/public-access/grants.
POST /mcp requires MCP-Protocol-Version, Mcp-Method, and params._meta (io.modelcontextprotocol/protocolVersion plus io.modelcontextprotocol/clientCapabilities); tools/call also requires Mcp-Name.
snapshot_digest is not a retrieval key after grant expiry; keep inline snapshot bytes or resubmit.
check_mcp_capability does not POST /v0/usage-events (usage_event_created is false) and does not disclose the Preview bearer.
public_access.notes: Short-lived Public Agent Preview access. Caller owns CONTINUE/UPDATE/HOLD. Live probing remains off.

usage_events.decision: client-attested CONTINUE, UPDATE_INTEGRATION, or HOLD; Exactlane does not derive it from the report
usage_events.report_consumed: required boolean; Exactlane does not infer it
usage_events.when: after a finished owned check, while the same credential is still valid

purpose: Caller-specific MCP capability compatibility evidence for a specific agent workflow before reliance. Static snapshot versus requirements; no live probing.

revision_checks.authoritative_result: global previous-to-current comparison of check results
revision_checks.baseline: the previous snapshot is re-evaluated; the supplied report is never trusted
revision_checks.check_report: unchanged exactlane.check-report/0.1, identical to POST /v0/checks at the same instant

isolated_change_evaluations.interaction_effects: INTERACTION_EFFECT_POSSIBLE whenever more than one change is present

revision_checks.mcp: check_mcp_capability with the optional previous argument
revision_checks.receipt_storage: not stored beyond the 24-hour idempotency replay
